title: Story Feature
description:
Typhoons' Last Storm
The British attacked German ships tragically carrying concentration camp prisoners.

title: Story Feature
description:
Stealing the Superfortress
A 2-hour investigation that answers one of WWII's most intriguing questions: How did the Soviet Union copy the U.S. B-29 Superfortress, the war's most advanced aircraft?

title: Story Feature
description:
History Undercover: The Other Tragedy at Pearl Harbor
Four veterans return for the first time to West Loch, Pearl Harbor, where the rusty tip of a submerged ship is all that's left of a mysterious accident they survived. On May 21, 1944, they were among the men assembled for the invasion of the Japanese stronghold at Saipan. Suddenly, there was a chain of explosions among the tightly berthed ships, and within minutes many of the combat-loaded ships were on fire. 127 servicemen died. The event remained classified until 1960, and the cause remains a mystery.

title: Story Feature
description:
The Bloody Hills of Peleliu
A chronology of the World War II battle that claimed 1,500 lives and wounded over 6,000. Examines the theory that the 72-day battle was strategically unnecessary.

title: Story Feature
description:
Massacre at Malmedy
Chronicles one of World War II's most infamous atrocities, the massacre of 86 American prisoners of war by the German SS in 1945. Includes an account of the war crimes trial in which 72 Germans were convicted for their part in the killings.

title: Story Feature
description:
Up the Deadly Boot: The Italian Campaign
Among WWII's spectacular blitzkriegs, amphibious leapfrogs, and breakthroughs, the savage Italian Campaign stands as one of the bloodiest. To the amazement of Germany, prepared to abandon Sicily, the Allies slogged in a death-filled march up the "boot.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Breakfast That Pops
Two heavy hitting cereal rivals duke it out for breakfast dominance. Competition heats up when an idea is stolen, beaten to the market, and is a runaway success.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Holiday Treats
The top selling candy days of the year revolve around Easter, Valentine's Day, and Halloween. And it all started with a few bold pioneers.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Flight of the Buffalo Wing
Before chicken wings were America's favorite Sunday football snack, they were considered an undesirable cut of meat. Until two restaurateurs in Buffalo, New York, reinvent the way wings are cooked.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Candy Revolution
A cereal executive's bold idea to finance the "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory" movie will kick-off a candy revolution that produces some of the most iconic, imaginative confections in history.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Clash of the Coffee
Coffee's quality and popularity wane by the 1960s, until a handful of visionaries turn the industry on its head. Three college friends create an iconic brand of revolutionary gourmet coffee.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
The Chicken Coup
A devout Georgia diner owner stumbles into the chicken game when he develops a unique fried chicken sandwich with a batch of cast-off filets.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
When Food Freezes Over
Four intrepid food entrepreneurs race to harness emerging technologies like the home freezer and microwave, to bring revolutionary frozen snack icons to a waiting world, and forever change what we eat, when we eat, and how we eat.

title: The Food That Built America
description:
Thanksgiving Dinner
Thanksgiving is the one night a year Americans celebrate by eating the same meal across the country. But 100 years ago, the spread varied from region to region, and some of the biggest staples of Thanksgiving Dinner weren't around.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
The Search for the Polio Vaccine
When "poliomyelitis" swept the nation, thousands died or were disabled before American ingenuity, trial and error, and blatant acts of desperation led to one of the greatest scientific breakthroughs in history. We'll see how polio shaped the vision of FDR, and catapulted the young unknown doctor Jonas Salk to international celebrity.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Antibiotics: The Wonder Drugs
In 1941, penicillin was first used to save human life. But now, bacteria has emerged resistant to every known antibiotic, and scientists have begun to fear that the era of the wonder drugs is near to its end.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Battlefield Medicine
He who would become a surgeon should join the army and follow it," Hippocrates counseled nearly 2,500 years ago. In this history of medicine under fire, we see how a small army of medics, nurses, surgeons, stretcher-bearers, and ambulance drivers races to keep pace with the deadly advances of war.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Prosthetics
From the earliest recorded account of an amputation and subsequent prosthesis in ancient Hindu writings, to a 16th-century fully-articulated artificial hand controlled by an intricate geared mechanism, to today's use of plastics and space-age materials, we chronicle the long history of prosthetic devices.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Physical Fitness: Quest for Health
Traces physical fitness' role in the health of the individual and society. From ancient Greek gymnasiums, where pupils pumped up the mind as well as body, to 19th-century Muscular Christians, who saw exercise as an obligation to God. Meet fitness gurus and fitness trainers, and test the latest and earliest exercise equipment.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Physical Fitness: Quest for Muscle
Meet the Strong Men and Women who go beyond mere fitness to pursue major muscle mass--from ancient Greeks, to performers in the 1800s astounding audiences with feats of strength, to the body builders of California's Muscle Beach! Lou Ferrigno and other stars share stories of the pursuit of muscle. Also looks at the effect of steroids.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Sports Technology: Equipment
To run faster, jump higher, and play longer--the ultimate goal of all athletes. But when training runs its course, science and technology jump in. Explore the history and technological advances in everything from athletic shoes to football gear. And leap into a future filled with radar-enhanced baseballs and virtual-reality stadiums.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
Shoes
Shoes have come a long way from their humble beginnings as simple leather moccasins. Today footwear is built to withstand any extreme environment where a foot can tread -- from the heart of a burning building to the track of an Olympic stadium. From high-tech soles to shoelaces, cowboy boots to sneaker design -- step behind the scenes with the products that keep your feet covered.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
The Barnsley Poltergeist
Unusual activity has been captured on CCTV at an antique centre in Barnsley, UK. It is suspected that a poltergeist may be the culprit. In search of the truth, paranormal investigator Jayne Harris has been despatched to see if she can gather proof for skeptical shop owner Daniel. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
Body in the Well
Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted by previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
Lady of the Night
The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history, and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors. Paranormal investigator MJ Dickson previously captured some interesting EVP recordings, but armed with new equipment, she is back and on the hunt for stronger evidence of the afterlife. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
The House in the Cemetery
Labyrinth Lodge in Liverpool in the UK is a haunted house in a cemetery. Originally it was a register office, recording births, deaths, and marriages. But it seems some previous residents just don’t want to leave. Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings-on in their home. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
The Haunted Hearse
The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
Hell's House
Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house, believed to have been the site of a fatal fire, in the 1970’s and 80s. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.  When she met her husband Kevin, he was a non-believer, but since staying at the house, he is a skeptic no longer. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
Evil Inns
In this, the first episode of Paranormal Captured, Series 2, we follow Paranormal Investigator Danny Moss as he explores the fascinating phenomenon of the haunted pub. Danny believes that many inns, bars, and public houses have a reputation for otherworldly activity because of their long and varied histories. In this episode, he examines the reputation of two of Britain’s most haunted pubs, and our experts review clips that purport to show paranormal activity from all around the globe.

title: Paranormal Captured
description:
The Occult
In the second episode of this series, Paranormal Investigator MJ Dickson explores that terrifying world of The Occult, examining two different sites renowned for their association with these dark arts and reviewing clips of otherworldly events captured from around the globe.
